name: Accordion · two-column cards
description: Eight short topics in two columns of shadow cards.

items.question: Location
items.answer: 12 Market Street, second floor. Step-free access from the side entrance.

items.question: Parking
items.answer: Free parking for two hours in the lot behind the building.

items.question: Payment
items.answer: We accept all major cards, Apple Pay and bank transfer.

items.question: Bookings
items.answer: Book online up to eight weeks ahead, or call us for same-day slots.

items.question: Accessibility
items.answer: Lift to all floors, accessible restrooms and hearing loop at reception.
